what_happened: Dispatch text names 'modules/home/services/sapience.nix's claudeMcpServers activation entry' as the top-level mcpServers.sapience merge. On disk, the generic 'claudeMcpServers' activation block lives in modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix (merges playwright+nixos only) and is a mere ordering dependency (entryAfter) for sapience.nix's own distinct activation block, named 'sapienceMcpServer' (gated by cfg.registerMcpServer), which performs the actual mcpServers.sapience merge at lines ~1019-1055. The implementation plan must target 'sapienceMcpServer' (and the registerMcpServer option), not touch dotfiles.nix's claudeMcpServers block, which is unrelated (playwright/nixos) and must survive unchanged.

All load-bearing claims in the dispatch were re-verified on disk and matched exactly: companion task 612 status COMPLETED in /home/benjamin/.config/nvim with both hook files installed mode 755; the four-repo extension-loaded set (.claude-extensions.json .extensions.sapience.status=='active') confirmed exactly as {.dotfiles, .config/nvim, Projects/abood, Projects/Sapience/sapience-app}, with cslib and Logos/Theory confirmed absent; settings-fragment.json carries all 11 grants and all 5 hooks byte-identical to dotfiles' current config/claude/settings.json; ~/.sapience/config.json's folders/capture.projects keys match the dispatch's verbatim transcription including the stale pre-move sapience-app path; ~/.claude.json top-level mcpServers still has sapience, and .projects currently registers only .config/nvim and the OLD /home/benjamin/Projects/sapience-app path (not yet the moved Projects/Sapience/sapience-app, and abood not yet registered -- expected, since no session has run there since the move/companion landing).

Research report claimed UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/SessionEnd/Stop each hold exactly one Sapience-only entry and all four arrays become empty. Live re-read of config/claude/settings.json shows SessionEnd holds TWO entries: the systemd-inhibitor cleanup (unrelated, must be KEPT) and the Sapience mcp.py --receipt entry. Plan corrected: SessionEnd key survives with one entry; only UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse and Stop are emptied and dropped.

Discovered a second, near-identical copy of the module at packages/sapience-flake/modules/sapience.nix (registerMcpServer at :195, sapienceMcpServer at :354) plus its own flake check asserting that option gates the merge, and README rows documenting it. That directory is a standalone publishable flake (its own flake.lock, checked separately via nix flake check ./packages/sapience-flake) and is NOT imported by modules/home/default.nix, so it is not a machine-wide surface active on this machine. Ruled explicitly out of scope in the plan to stop an implementer editing it.

Found doc/comment staleness beyond both the dispatch enumeration and the research report: docs/sapience.md inspection recipe (jq .mcpServers.sapience ~/.claude.json), module options table rows for enable and registerMcpServer, sapience.nix header comments at lines 12-14 and 49-50, the sapienceTokenRepair comments at 931/936 referencing sapienceMcpServer, and home.nix line 36 claiming enabling the module installs the MCP registration. All enumerated as explicit plan tasks.

Reading modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix revealed the enforced-key list is exactly [_NOTE, env, hooks, model, permissions, statusLine] -- _SAPIENCE_NOTE is NOT enforced, so a rewritten note does not propagate to the live file when a live copy already exists. Captured as an explicit verification caveat so the implementer does not read a stale live note as a failed switch.

Phase 3's named verification suite (run-all.sh --only ...) includes two failures unrelated to this task's edits: test-gate-registry-resolution.sh (1/44 case failure, marked NEW by run-all but concerning gate-registry resolution, nothing touched by this task) and test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh (9/21 failures, all due to 'hook identity bridge not found: lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/hook_identity_cli.lua' -- that path belongs to the nvim config repo's lua/ tree, which does not exist in .dotfiles at all; a pre-existing cross-repo infra mismatch). test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh, the suite the plan specifically names as bearing on this phase's edit, PASSED cleanly. Neither failing suite references sapience, config/claude/settings.json, or modules/home/services/sapience.nix.

Phase 6's positive-test spot-check found that two of the four extension-loaded repositories (/home/benjamin/Projects/abood and /home/benjamin/Projects/Sapience/sapience-app) still show only 4 mcp__sapience__* grants and 0 Sapience hooks in their deployed .claude/settings.local.json, versus the expected 11 grants / 5 hooks that /home/benjamin/.dotfiles and /home/benjamin/.config/nvim both correctly show. This is the pre-companion grant count (the four write-tool grants that predate project 612), meaning those two repos' own .claude/ deploy has not been refreshed ([Reload All]/deploy sync) since the companion extension-side task landed its settings-fragment.json update. This is outside this task's edit-target list (modules/home/services/sapience.nix, config/claude/settings.json, docs/sapience.md, home.nix, all in .dotfiles) and outside its file_scope -- refreshing another repository's own deploy artifacts is that repository's own action, not an edit this task performs. Recorded for visibility; acceptance criterion 3 is about what THIS task's change preserves, not about syncing sibling repos' deploy state.

Phase 6 found that removing the sapienceMcpServer activation entry (Phase 2) does not retroactively remove the already-written top-level mcpServers.sapience key from the live ~/.claude.json -- that activation entry only ever merged/wrote the key additively on each switch; ~/.claude.json carries no enforced-key reset semantics the way ~/.claude/settings.json does. The plan's Phase 6 verification ('jq -r .mcpServers | keys[] must no longer list sapience') implicitly assumed removing the writer would also erase the stale value, which is not how the mechanism works. Fixed forward: performed a one-time jq del(.mcpServers.sapience) against the live ~/.claude.json (not owner-only state like ~/.sapience/config.json -- this file's mcpServers.sapience sub-key was written entirely by this repository's own activation entries, now removed), preserving every other top-level key (confirmed via full key-set diff against the Phase 1 baseline, which matched exactly). This is recorded as a plan gap rather than an implementer error: no phase named this one-time cleanup as a task.
